summary: Frontend-only test of the PMSC page (/pmpe.html) and the homepage. Tested at 1920x1080, 390x844 and 412x915. Everything passed except one issue: the document <title> still read 'PMPE - Polícia Militar de Pernambuco | Instituto AOCP'. I fixed it to 'PMSC - Polícia Militar de Santa Catarina | Instituto AOCP' and confirmed the live page serves the new title. Results: the modal 'COMUNICADO AOS CANDIDATOS' mentions PMSC and 15/11/2026. Both #avisoOk and #avisoClose dismiss it, and it does not come back on reload in the same session. The logo loads (naturalWidth=366). Title and CFP description are correct, and the body text has no Pernambuco or PMPE. Inscreva-se and Inscrição Online both go to /termos.html?c=pmpe. The page shows exactly 3 links and 5 publicações with the expected dates. Home / -> Acessar -> /pmpe.html works. On mobile there is no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth == viewport width) and the modal fits inside the viewport with 16px margins.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser tab title still said 'PMPE - Polícia Militar de Pernambuco'. Fixed by the testing agent.

critical_code_review_comments: The homepage at / is served directly at '/' (the URL stays '/'); it is not a redirect to /inicio.html. Content and navigation are correct either way.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the title fix (before the fix: 1 failure in the 'no Pernambuco anywhere' check)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static page. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded'. For link clicks, wrap in page.expect_navigation, because wait_for_load_state returns before navigation starts. The modal uses sessionStorage key 'aviso_prazo_pmpe'; clear it to see the modal again.
